spans.s: To be, become; कथमेवं भवेन्नाम; अस्याः किमभवत्
‘what has become her fate’, ‘what has become of her’
‘come what may’; so दुःखितो भवति, हृष्टो भवति &c.
To be born or produced; यदपत्यं भवेदस्याम्
To spring or proceed from, arise; क्रोधाद् भवति संमोहः
To happen, take place, occur; नाततायिवधे दोषो हन्तुर्भवति कश्चन

To live, exist; अभूदभूतपूर्वः … राजा चिन्तामणिर्नाम Vās.;
 अभून्नृपो विबुधसखः परंतपः

To be alive or living, breathe; त्वमिदानीं न भविष्यसि Ś. 6;
 आः चारुदत्तहतक, अयं न भवसि

(‘thou art a dead man’, thou shalt breathe no longer);
 ऋतेऽपि त्वा न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे

To remain or be in any state or condition, fare; भवान् स्थले कथं
 भविष्यति
To stay, abide; remain; अस्मिन्नेव लतागृहे त्वमभवस्तन्मार्गदत्तेक्षणः
To serve, do; इदं पादोदकं भविष्यति Ś. 1.

To be possible (usually with a future tense in this sense); भवति
 भवान् याजयिष्यति Sk.
To be on the side of, assist; देवा अर्जुनतोऽभवन् ।

To belong or pertain to (often expressed by ‘have’); तस्य ह शतं
 जाया बभूवुः Ait. Br.; तस्य तेजोमया लोका भवन्ति ब्रह्मवादिनः

To be engaged in, be occupied (with loc.); चरणक्षालने कृष्णो ब्राह्मणानां
 स्वयं ह्यभूत् Mb.
Ved. To be prosperous, succeed; ततो देवा अभवन् Bṛ.

. Used with a preceding noun or adjective भू serves
 to form verbs in the sense of ‘becoming what it previously is not’ or
 ‘becoming’ in general; श्वेतीभू to become white; कृष्णीभू to become
 black; पयोधरीभूत ‘becoming or serving the purpose of teats’; so
 क्षपणीभू to be or become a mendicant; प्रणिधीभू to act the spy;
 आर्द्रीभू to melt; भस्मीभू to be reduced to ashes; विषयीभू
 to form the subject of; so एकमतीभू; तरुणीभू &c. &c. Note:− The
 senses of भू may be variously modified according to the adverbs with
 which it is connected; e. g. पुनर्भू to marry again; आविर्भू
 to appear, arise, to be evident or clear; see आविस्; तिरोभू to disappear;
 प्रादुर्भू to arise, be visible, appear; अग्रेभू to be in front,
 take the lead; अन्तर्भू to be absorbed or included; ओजस्यन्तर्भवन्त्यन्ये
 K.

; दोषाभू to grow evening or dusk-time; अन्यथा भू to be
 otherwise, be changed; न मे वचनमन्यथा भवितुमर्हति Ś. 4; पुरो
 भू to come forward; stand forth; मिथ्या भू to turn out false; वृथा
 भू to become useless &c. &c. ━Caus. (भावयति-ते)

To cause to be or become, call into existence, call into being; ते
 वै ब्रह्मण आदेशात् कथमेतदभावयन्

To foster, cherish, support, preserve, enliven; पुनः सृजति वर्षाणि
 भगवान् भावयन् प्रजाः Mb.; देवान् भावयतानेन ते देवा भाव्यन्तु वः ।
 परस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ ॥
To think or reflect, consider, fancy, imagine.
To look upon, consider or regard as; अर्थमनर्थं भावय नित्यम् Moha

To prove, substantiate, establish; निह्नवे भावितो दद्याद्धनं राज्ञे
 च तत्समम्
To devote or addict oneself to.

To perfume, scent. ━Desid. (बुभूषति) To wish to be or
 become &c. ━II. €1 U. (भवति-ते) To get, obtain. ━III. €10 Ā. (भावयते)
 To obtain, gain. ━IV. €10 U. (भावयति-ते)
To be purified (connected with caus. of भू q. v. above).
I. €1 P. (rarely Ā.) (भवति, बभूव, अभूत्, भविष्यति, भवितुम्, भूत)

(At the end of comp.) Being, existing, becoming, springing
 from, arising or produced from, &c.; चित्तभू, आत्मभू, कमलभू, मनोभू &c. ━m.
